# Paul Irving & Shirley

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Friend of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — student fond of his teacher · since v2  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>
- [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — teacher and pupil · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and forming a quick bond with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while struggling with [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the pronunciation of her family's name and her son's name. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home feeling relieved after [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives her flowers, and she later discusses the day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her experiences teaching at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, sharing funny student remarks and compositions. She recounts how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) admitted to copying love letters for her assignment and highlights a imaginative letter written by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses up to visit Miss Lavendar, leading to a humorous dinner conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they enjoy lunch, test the echoes, and chat in the garden with Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031)_

> While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan an extended visit during her vacation to cheer her up. After returning to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea, Miss Lavendar and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) share a tender conversation about their shared imagination and dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) depart.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps Miss Lavendar make a new dress before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note and helps an excited Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) busies herself helping Miss Lavendar prepare for her upcoming wedding while receiving visits from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Later, after discussing the romantic nature of the match with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) then visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to officially announce her engagement, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love and her own romantic ideals.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is devastated to learn that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is gravely ill with typhoid fever. During a painful night of vigil, she comes to the sudden realization that she loves [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and always has. The next morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) delivers the joyous news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
